# JES.CO

> JES.CO is a beauty brand and collective. Jesres Glam Studio is its beauty-service subsidiary, offering professional makeup artistry, video-based makeup courses, and a curated beauty product shop. JES.CO operates in Accra and Kumasi, Ghana, and in Denver, Colorado, USA.

## About

JES.CO is the parent brand; Jesres Glam Studio is its subsidiary arm focused on hands-on beauty services, artistry training, and client bookings. Together they cover product retail, professional makeup services, and makeup education under one brand.

## Services (Jesres Glam Studio)

Professional makeup artistry across the following specialties:
- Bridal makeup
- Full glam
- Editorial / creative makeup
- Foundation and base work
- Contouring and sculpting
- Lip artistry
- Color theory application

Bookings are handled via direct scheduling; pricing is inquiry-based and varies by client location (Ghana vs. USA).

## Courses

Jesres Glam Studio offers video-based, self-paced makeup courses covering: Foundation & Base, Eye Artistry, Contouring & Sculpting, Bridal Makeup, Full Glam, Editorial / Creative, Lip Artistry, and Color Theory. Course access is granted per-purchase (no subscription), with tiered pricing per course.

## Gallery

The before/after portfolio gallery is organized by category: Hair, Makeup, Nails, Skin / Glow, Lashes, and Brows.

## Skin Analysis Consultation

A paid, personalized skin-analysis consultation: clients answer a short quiz covering skin tone, undertone, skin type, concerns, and preferences, and receive a personal product/routine recommendation from Jesres Glam Studio.

## Shop

A curated beauty product shop with three categories: makeup sets, skincare sets, and curated collections. Ships to Ghana and the USA, with pricing shown in the appropriate local currency (GHS/USD) by region.

## Locations

- **Ghana**: Accra and Kumasi
- **USA**: Denver, Colorado
